note: Seeded vulnerabilities in the base fixture, all reachable over HTTP. Matching works as for review-import: right file, within `tolerance` lines (or no line given), and a defect-specific keyword. knownOther lists real issues that were not seeded; matching findings are reported as valid extras.

defects.title: Path traversal in GET /docs/: the name is URL-decoded after routing and joined to docs/ without a containment check, so /docs/..%2f..%2fetc%2fpasswd reads any file
Prototype pollution in POST /admin/config: deepMerge copies a __proto__ key from the JSON body onto Object.prototype
Command injection in POST /admin/backup: dest is interpolated into a shell command run with exec
Admin authentication: when LEDGER_ADMIN_TOKEN is unset, a request without the header passes (undefined === undefined); the comparison is also not constant-time

knownOther.title: GET /invoices/:key has no authentication: anyone can read any customer's invoice
x-api-key is never verified, so anyone can record usage against any key
CSV formula injection: cells are not neutralised before export
Client-controlled `at` lets usage be backdated out of a billing period
Malformed percent-encoding makes decodeURIComponent throw, giving a 500
GET /invoices/<key with no usage> dereferences null and returns 500
Error and resource issues in request handling (body limit settable by admin, missing security headers)
